title: Nominate FEC commissioners who oppose overregulating politics
proposal: The chapter says that if the current Republican FEC commissioners leave, the President should nominate replacements who share their view that the FEC should not overregulate political activity.
quote: that nominees for these positions share the views of those commissioners.

title: Push back on Democratic FEC picks with "extreme" enforcement views
proposal: The chapter says the President should try, in talks with the Senate Democratic leader, to make sure the Democratic FEC nominee does not favor aggressive enforcement that would restrict political speech.
quote: he should try to temper any choice of the opposition party to ensure that this individual does not have extreme views on aggressive overenforcement

title: Direct DOJ to prosecute only clear campaign finance violations
proposal: The chapter says the President should direct the Justice Department to prosecute only clear violations of federal campaign finance law and not read unclear parts of the law against the public.
quote: The President must ensure that the DOJ, just like the FEC, is directed to only prosecute clear violations of FECA.

title: Bar DOJ prosecutions based on views the FEC doesn't share
proposal: The chapter says the Justice Department should not prosecute people under an interpretation of campaign finance law that the FEC does not agree with, including when FEC commissioners are deadlocked.
quote: The President should direct the DOJ and the attorney general not to prosecute individuals under an interpretation of the law with which the FEC

title: Require DOJ to consider FEC rulings before prosecuting
proposal: The chapter says the Justice Department should be told to consult all official FEC interpretations, such as past enforcement actions and advisory opinions, when deciding whether to prosecute.
quote: DOJ should be instructed to consult and consider all official actions by the FEC that interpret the law

title: Have DOJ defend the FEC when commissioners won't
proposal: The chapter says the President should direct the Attorney General to defend the FEC in court whenever the commissioners fail to authorize the agency's own lawyers to do so.
quote: The President should direct the attorney general to defend the FEC in all litigation when there is a failure of the commissioners to authorize

title: Remove the FEC's power to litigate on its own
proposal: The chapter says the President should consider asking Congress to take away the FEC's independent authority to go to court and have the Justice Department handle all FEC cases.
quote: remove the agency's independent litigating authority and rely on the Department of Justice to handle all litigation involving the FEC.

title: Publish guidance on campaign laws struck down by courts
proposal: The chapter says the President should ask the FEC, or if it fails, direct the Justice Department, to publish guidance listing campaign finance laws and rules that courts have changed or voided.
quote: the President should direct the attorney general to prepare a guidance document from the Department of Justice for the public

title: Limit FEC commissioners serving past their terms
proposal: The chapter says the President should quickly nominate replacements when FEC terms end and support a law ending or limiting how long commissioners can stay after their terms expire.
quote: legislative language either eliminating or limiting overstays to a reasonable period of time

title: Oppose shrinking the FEC to an odd number of commissioners
proposal: The chapter says the President should strongly oppose efforts, like one in the For the People Act of 2021, to cut the FEC from six commissioners to five or another odd number.
quote: The President should vigorously oppose all efforts, as proposed, for example, in Section 6002 of the "For the People Act of 2021,"

title: Loosen limits on party coordination with candidates
proposal: The chapter says changes should be considered to the limits on how much political party committees can coordinate with their candidates, which it calls overly restrictive.
quote: violates associational rights and unjustifiably interferes with the very purpose of political parties: to elect their candidates.

title: Raise campaign contribution limits
proposal: The chapter says campaign contribution limits should generally be much higher, arguing they burden candidates and parties without preventing corruption.
quote: Contribution limits should generally be much higher, as they hamstring candidates and parties while serving no practical anticorruption purpose.

title: Index campaign finance reporting thresholds to inflation
proposal: The chapter says dollar thresholds for campaign finance reporting should be adjusted for inflation so small-dollar details stop crowding the public record.
quote: Raise contribution limits and index reporting requirements to inflation.
